practice_sessions_completed_fields.name: practice_sessions_completed_fields
practice_sessions_completed_fields.value: "practice_sessions"."status" <> 'completed' or ("practice_sessions"."completed_at" is not null and "practice_sessions"."self_rating" is not null)

review_tasks_kind_milestone.name: review_tasks_kind_milestone
review_tasks_kind_milestone.value: ("review_tasks"."kind" = 'scheduled' and "review_tasks"."milestone_days" in (3, 7, 21)) or ("review_tasks"."kind" = 'extra' and "review_tasks"."milestone_days" is null)
